item.text: “Did you forget this bit?” the visitor asked, pointing to the bare square between the roses. “No,” said the gardener. “Won’t weeds grow?” “Probably.” “Then why leave it?” The gardener rested his hands on his spade. “My wife always said I planted things too close together.” “So it’s a memorial?” “Not exactly.” He glanced toward the house, where she stood watching through the kitchen window. “It’s where she’s going to put that ugly frog statue. We’re still negotiating the size.”
